standard_prerequisites.name: Sequent derivability
standard_prerequisites.statement: Gamma derives A when some finite subset Gamma_0 of Gamma has a derivation of the sequent Gamma_0 with succedent A.
standard_prerequisites.use: It produces the finite subset Gamma_0 the proof works with (2285-2288).

standard_prerequisites.name: Soundness of the sequent calculus
standard_prerequisites.statement: Every derivable sequent is valid; the unit proves this as its soundness theorem.
standard_prerequisites.use: It upgrades the sequent Gamma_0 to A to its semantic validity (2288-2291).

core_obligations: From Gamma derives A take the finite subset Gamma_0 with a derivation of Gamma_0 to A (2285-2288).
By soundness every structure that satisfies all of Gamma_0 also satisfies A (2288-2291).
Since Gamma_0 is part of Gamma, every structure satisfying Gamma satisfies A, which is the counted entailment (2291-2293).

proof_roadmap.step: Extract the finite support Gamma_0 from the derivation.
Apply soundness and read off the entailment.

difficulty_reason: The counted corollary is the author corollary at source lines 2281-2283: if Gamma derives A in the sequent calculus then Gamma entails A. The author proof (2285-2293) unpacks derivability into a derivation from a finite subset Gamma_0, invokes the unit's sequent soundness theorem to conclude that every structure either falsifies a member of Gamma_0 or satisfies A, and reads entailment off directly. The passage from the infinite premise set to its finite witness is the counted move.
